extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia users/editors trying to create or find an article (specifically someone looking for 'QAnon jokes')
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for creating or locating a Wikipedia page (here: the missing 'QAnon jokes' article), including account requirements, search/redirect checks, and options for submitting drafts or requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is presented as a prerequisite for creating new pages; if you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard, submit a draft, or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create the page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed) follow these alternative workflows to propose the article for review or creation by others.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles or alternative titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'QAnon jokes' in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under the same or a different title to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can reveal existing coverage or appropriate target pages; use links to determine if a standalone article is warranted or where to merge content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page creation may be delayed / try purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an expected page is missing, allow time for propagation or manually purge to refresh; do not immediately assume it doesn't exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (except first character) and consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and spelling; if a page exists under a different capitalization, create a redirect rather than a duplicate article.

rubrics_metrics.name: If deleted, check deletion log and deletion reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investigate deletion history to understand whether deletion was for notability, policy violation, or another reason before reattempting creation; use the log to guide revisions or appeals.
